documents.title: Synthetic Workplace and Facility Safety Standard

clauses.title: Clear emergency egress
clauses.text: Emergency exits, exit doors, and evacuation routes must remain clear and unobstructed at all times. Storage boxes, pallets, waste containers, and inventory must not block immediate egress.

clauses.title: Exit signage
clauses.text: Emergency exits must be identified by illuminated, photoluminescent, or high-contrast signs that remain visible from the occupied work area.

clauses.title: Electrical panel identification
clauses.text: Electrical panels and their circuits must have complete, durable, and legible identification labels.

clauses.title: Emergency shutoff access
clauses.text: Emergency electrical shutoff devices must remain visible, reachable, and free from obstruction.

clauses.title: Cable protection
clauses.text: Installed cables and cable trays must be covered or otherwise protected against accidental contact and physical damage.

clauses.title: Waste traceability
clauses.text: Industrial and office waste must be documented and traceable from its point of origin through final disposal or recycling.

clauses.title: Protective footwear
clauses.text: Workers in designated loading areas must wear approved protective footwear.

clauses.title: Encryption at rest
clauses.text: Sensitive personal identifiers stored in databases or other non-volatile systems must be encrypted with approved cryptographic algorithms.

clauses.title: Right to erasure
clauses.text: Verified requests for deletion of personal data must be completed without undue delay and no later than thirty days after receipt.

clauses.title: Data protection officer contact
clauses.text: The organization must publish accurate contact details that allow data subjects to reach its designated Data Protection Officer easily.

clauses.title: Retention review
clauses.text: Retention schedules must be reviewed annually and obsolete records must be disposed of securely.

documents.title: Synthetic Information and Physical Security Standard

clauses.title: Cryptographic key protection
clauses.text: Cryptographic keys must be protected against unauthorized disclosure, replacement, and storage in plaintext systems.

clauses.title: Physical entry records
clauses.text: Entry to sensitive facilities must be controlled and visitor access must be recorded in complete, reviewable logs.

clauses.title: Network perimeter
clauses.text: Firewall and network boundary rules must prevent unauthorized traffic and obsolete permissive rules must be removed.

clauses.title: Critical patching
clauses.text: Critical operating-system and application security patches must be applied to endpoints within fourteen days of release.

clauses.title: Equipment anchoring
clauses.text: Server racks and comparable hardware infrastructure must be permanently anchored to the building structure to resist movement and unauthorized removal.

clauses.title: Backup testing
clauses.text: Backups of critical systems must be restored in a test environment at least once each year.

clauses.title: Site contact records
clauses.text: Each facility must maintain current emergency contact details and accurate ownership information.

clauses.title: Visitor directions
clauses.text: Public-facing facilities should display clear directions to their reception area.
